teaser: Before blaming business for not patching php2shell, ask how good the number is, and what makes a site actually vulnerable.
core_idea: Every 'unpatched' figure for php2shell is a count of version strings, in different units, distorted by backports and hidden versions; Italy's 81.9% is of the readable half, 38.5% of all detected. A site is vulnerable only if it is reachable, unprotected at the edge, on a runtime the exploit fits, holds something worth taking and is unwatched. With no named victim six days in and 17 exploited flaws listed by CISA in the same fortnight, not patching is more likely a wrong count and rational prioritisation than negligence.
